results.name: Equiv.trans

/-- Composition of equivalences `e₁ : α ≃ β` and `e₂ : β ≃ γ`. -/
@[trans]
protected def trans (e₁ : α ≃ β) (e₂ : β ≃ γ) : α ≃ γ :=
  ⟨e₂ ∘ e₁, e₁.symm ∘ e₂.symm, e₂.left_inv.comp e₁.left_inv, e₂.right_inv.comp e₁.right_inv⟩
results.docstring: Composition of equivalences `e₁ : α ≃ β` and `e₂ : β ≃ γ`.

results.name: Equiv.sumEquivSigmalCond
results.source_text:
/-- An alternative form of `Equiv.sumEquivSigmaBool` where `Bool.casesOn` is replaced by `cond`. -/
def sumEquivSigmalCond : Fin m ⊕ Fin n ≃ Σ b, cond b (Fin m) (Fin n) :=
  calc Fin m ⊕ Fin n
    _ ≃ Fin n ⊕ Fin m := sumComm ..
    _ ≃ Σ b, bif b then (Fin m) else (Fin n) := sumEquivSigmaBool ..
    _ ≃ Σ b, cond b (Fin m) (Fin n) := sigmaCongrRight (fun | true | false => Equiv.refl _)
results.docstring: An alternative form of `Equiv.sumEquivSigmaBool` where `Bool.casesOn` is replaced by `cond`.

results.name: finsum
results.source_text:
/-- Sum of `f x` as `x` ranges over the elements of the support of `f`, if it's finite. Zero
otherwise. -/
noncomputable irreducible_def finsum (lemma := finsum_def') [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) : M :=
  if h : HasFiniteSupport (f ∘ PLift.down) then ∑ i ∈ h.toFinset, f i.down else 0
results.docstring:
Sum of `f x` as `x` ranges over the elements of the support of `f`, if it's finite. Zero
otherwise.

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.physicalProbability
results.source_text:
/-- The dimensionless physical probability density. This is is the probability density w.r.t. the
measure, obtained by dividing the phase space measure by the fundamental unit `h^dof`, making the
probability density `ρ_phys = ρ_math * h^dof` dimensionless. -/
noncomputable def physicalProbability (T : Temperature) (i : ι) : ℝ :=
  𝓒.probability T i * (𝓒.phaseSpaceunit ^ 𝓒.dof)
results.docstring:
The dimensionless physical probability density. This is is the probability density w.r.t. the
measure, obtained by dividing the phase space measure by the fundamental unit `h^dof`, making the
probability density `ρ_phys = ρ_math * h^dof` dimensionless.

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.physicalProbability_nonneg
results.source_text:
lemma physicalProbability_nonneg
    (T : Temperature) [IsFiniteMeasure (𝓒.μBolt T)] [NeZero 𝓒.μ] (i : ι) :
    0 ≤ 𝓒.physicalProbability T i :=
  mul_nonneg (𝓒.probability_nonneg T i) (pow_nonneg 𝓒.hPos.le _)

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.physicalProbability_measurable
results.source_text:
lemma physicalProbability_measurable (T : Temperature) :
    Measurable (𝓒.physicalProbability T) := by
  unfold physicalProbability probability
  fun_prop

results.name: allPhyslibModules
results.source_text:
/-- Gets an array of all module names in `Physlib`. -/
def allPhyslibModules : IO (Array Lean.Name) := do
  let paths ← allFilePaths
  let moduleNames := paths.map fun path =>
    let relativePath := path.toString.replace "./Physlib/" "Physlib."
    let noExt := relativePath.replace ".lean" ""
    let nameStr := noExt.replace "/" "."
    String.toName nameStr
  pure moduleNames
results.docstring: Gets an array of all module names in `Physlib`.

results.name: allFilePaths
results.source_text:
/-- Gets an array of all file paths in `Physlib`. -/
partial def allFilePaths : IO (Array FilePath) := do
  allFilePaths.go (#[] : Array FilePath) "./Physlib" ("./Physlib" : FilePath)
results.docstring: Gets an array of all file paths in `Physlib`.

results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
